definitions.explanation: going somewhere with the intention of staying overnight, rather than returning the same day

examples.japanese: {泊|と}まりがけ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I'm going to the hot springs for an overnight stay.

examples.japanese: {泊|と}まりがけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I have an overnight business trip.
I went to stay overnight at my friend's house.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
⟦{泊|と}まり→泊まり：22935_tomari⟧ (staying) + がけ (in the process of/about to)

USAGE:
- {泊|と}まりがけ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ - with an overnight stay (adverbial use)
- {泊|と}まりがけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧～ - ～ involving an overnight stay
- ⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧ (business trip)
- ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧ (travel)
- ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧ (hot springs)
- ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧ (friend's house)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {泊|と}まりがけ - overnight stay (planned)
- ⟦{日帰|ひがえ}り→日帰り：17612_higaeri⟧ - day trip (returning same day)
- ⟦{外泊|がいはく}→外泊：17613_gaihaku⟧ - staying out overnight (often unplanned)
